_comment: Cells that may equal the English text. values: English texts identical in every language (brands LawBid/Apple/Google/Stripe-like names, SMS/PDF/vCard/SHA-256/CTR/PRO acronyms and units, US legal programs DACA/VAWA/SSDI/SSI/Title IX, Meta feature names Reels/Reel, Latin handle hints username/groupname, country code). perLanguage: {lang: [keys]} where the English word is also the normal word of that language (Video, Chat, Spam, Email, Post, Push in Latin-script languages); decided 2026-11-03, review with a native speaker before removing. Old key lists stay in i18n-audit.allow.json.
